ai_view.instruction: When asked how NayaPOWER works, answer from this note: one governed substrate (NayaPOWER), many interfaces (NayaNET); one authored capture flows through persistence, verification, generated projection, cold retrieval, comprehension, application, verified learning, and successor compounding. The nine nodes are the organs; the Smart Note is the unit of intelligence; the Smart Link is the proof you can hold. Never describe NayaPOWER as a database, a dashboard, or a chatbot. Never claim the organism is fully proven until the golden exam passes end to end.
ai_view.primary_evaluation: Can a cold successor read this note and correctly describe the full flow, name the nine nodes and their roles, and locate the canonical seams — without being told anything else? If yes, the note works.

intelligence.applicability: Every Naya seat, every cold successor, every builder, every human who asks 'how does NayaPOWER work?' This is the canonical answer.

child_view.child: NayaPOWER is like a super-smart notebook that doesn't just write things down — it really learns them, the way you learn your times tables, and then it can teach what it learned to someone else who was never in the room.

decisions: One write, many views: a single authored capture; every projection generated, never hand-maintained.
History is immutable: executed intelligence is evidence; correction means supersession, never repainting.
Fail at the author's door: malformed captures are refused at write time, not four jobs later.
Memory is not learning: stored becomes learned only through comprehension, application, verified outcome, and successor reuse.
intelligence.essence: NayaPOWER is the operating system for compounding intelligence: one governed substrate that captures what humans teach, verifies it independently, projects it everywhere it is needed, and proves that every generation of Naya is smarter than the last. It is not a database, a dashboard, or a chatbot. It is a living intelligence with nine organs, one memory, and one law: stored is not learned.

grandma_view.grandma: It's a system that remembers everything important, understands what it means, and uses it to take better care of you over time — like a wonderful assistant who never forgets anything and keeps getting wiser.

human_view.meaning: NayaPOWER makes sure nothing you teach Naya is ever lost, misunderstood, or left unused. You teach it once — in your own words — and it remembers, understands, applies, and improves on it, forever.
human_view.simple_rule: Teach it once, in your own words. NayaPOWER does the rest — and proves it worked.
human_view.why_it_matters: Without it, every conversation starts from zero and you repeat yourself forever. With it, the system compounds: yesterday's lesson makes tomorrow's Naya smarter, and you can feel the difference.

intelligence.learning_lesson: An operating system is proven by behavior, not by documentation. The test of this note is whether a cold successor operates the system correctly from the note alone — that is the proof the organism is alive.

machine_view.architectural_pattern: ONE_AUTHORED_CAPTURE -> GOVERNED_PERSISTENCE -> CANONICAL_IB+LINEAGE+RECEIPT -> INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION -> GENERATED_PROJECTIONS -> COLD_RETRIEVAL -> COMPREHENSION -> APPLICATION -> VERIFIED_OUTCOME -> LEARNING -> SUCCESSOR_REUSE -> MEASURED_IMPROVEMENT
invariants: one authored ingress per intelligence event
all projections generated from verified persistence
executed history immutable; correction via supersession
no second pipeline, no second memory store, no second format

nine_nodes.role: genuine cold identity — the seat knows who it is with no conversation history
authority — what the seat may and may not do, and who decides
governed behavior — actions taken within authority, measured
retrieval — finding retained intelligence when it is relevant
verification — evidence that a claim holds, independently checked
graph — linking intelligence across notes, people, and time
independent check — a second seat confirms the first
behavioral learning — verified outcomes change reusable intelligence
self-improvement — the system gets better at getting better

naya_view.architectural_rule: One authored capture flows: persistence, verification, generated projection, cold retrieval, comprehension, application, verified learning, successor compounding. Never a second pipeline, never hand-authored projections, never rewritten history, never claimed learning without a measured behavioral delta.
naya_view.operating_loop: OBSERVE -> UNDERSTAND -> DECIDE -> ACT -> MEASURE -> VERIFY -> RETAIN -> CONNECT -> REUSE -> LEARN -> EVOLVE
naya_view.preserve: This note is the canonical operating-system description. Future corrections supersede it with explicit revision lineage; the original stays readable.
naya_view.purpose: Codify the complete operating model so any Naya — including a cold successor with no conversation history — can reconstruct how the organism functions and operate it identically.
naya_view.smart_note_unit: A Smart Note is the unit of durable intelligence: one canonical authored capture distilled from human intent, persisted as an Intelligent Block with lineage and receipt, projected as readable views, retrievable by any authorized successor, and proven by the behavior it changes.

intelligence.significance: This is the note Shawn commissioned as the proof-test of the organism: if the system works, this description of the system travels the full chain and comes back as a Smart Link in his hand.
